findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.mobileaccounting.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: month_end_checklist · Private data: find_contacts, get_installment_plan, sales_tax_returns, log_time, insights, update_contact, sales_tax_claims, cash_forecast, check_tax_exemption, tax_exemption_certificates, record_bill, record_journal_entry, record_expense, get_document, customer_portal, get_card_fee_setting, find_documents · Public sink: sales_tax_claims, month_end_checklist, spending, sales_by_customer, record_journal_entry · Destructive: update_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: month_end_checklist · Private data: find_contacts, get_installment_plan, sales_tax_returns, log_time, insights, update_contact, sales_tax_claims, cash_forecast, check_tax_exemption, tax_exemption_certificates, record_bill, record_journal_entry, record_expense, get_document, customer_portal, get_card_fee_setting, find_documents · Public sink: sales_tax_claims, month_end_checklist, spending, sales_by_customer, record_journal_entry · Destructive: update_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
